status: Targeted gap-filling searches run through the PubMed plugin; AI Reviewer-1 abstract inspection only

searches.query: (nicotine[Title] OR tobacco[Title]) AND (attention deficit hyperactivity disorder[Title/Abstract] OR ADHD[Title/Abstract]) AND (attention[Title/Abstract] OR cognition[Title/Abstract] OR symptoms[Title/Abstract])
searches.purpose: Direct evidence for nicotine activation/attention effects and nicotine-prescription-stimulant interaction.

searches.query: (cannabis OR THC) AND (psychosis OR bipolar OR mania) AND (systematic review[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type])
searches.purpose: High-level current synthesis of psychiatric, psychosis, cognitive, mania, and mood-course outcomes.

searches.query: ((adult ADHD[Title/Abstract] OR adult autism[Title/Abstract]) AND (retrospective recall[Title/Abstract] OR childhood recall[Title/Abstract] OR self-report bias[Title/Abstract] OR diagnostic recall[Title/Abstract])) OR ((psychiatric diagnosis[Title/Abstract]) AND (confirmation bias[Title/Abstract] OR narrative bias[Title/Abstract]))
searches.purpose: Directly test retrospective-onset uncertainty and confirmation-bias counterclaims.

inspection_rule: Each selected PMID was fetched with PubMed abstract_plus and its abstract inspected before evidence extraction. Full metadata is re-fetched by the local verification script.
